title: Warm Velvety Kenyan Italian Sausage Stew
description: A sour and velvety stew featuring Italian fennel sausages, perfect for a sick day, with a blend of Kenyan flavors, this dish is easy to make and delicious to eat, with a tempering of spices to bring out the flavors.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced Italian fennel sausages and cook until browned.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and stir to combine.
Add the sliced kenyan chili peppers, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot over rice or with some crusty bread.
